rows.label: bf03040100_0010
rows.name: Uncle! Uncle Umon! Where are you, mo?

rows.label: bf03040100_0020
rows.name:
Who is it, mo? You're making a racket
while I'm trying to work, mo.

rows.label: bf03040100_0030
rows.name: Oh? It's you, Tora, mo.

rows.label: bf03040100_0040
rows.name: Long time no see, Uncle, mo.

rows.label: bf03040100_0050
rows.name:
Yeah, long time no see, mo.
About a year, mo?

rows.label: bf03040100_0060
rows.name: Yeah, right about that, mo.

rows.label: bf03040100_0070
rows.name: You've grown quite a lot in a year, mo.

rows.label: bf03040100_0080
rows.name: That's what they call a growth spurt, mo.

rows.label: bf03040100_0090
rows.name:
And you've brought a lot
of sidekicks with you...

rows.label: bf03040100_0100
rows.name:
Boss and the others aren't sidekicks!
They're friends, mo!

rows.label: bf03040100_0110
rows.name: Boss, this is Uncle Umon.

rows.label: bf03040100_0120
rows.name:
He used to research with Grandpa Senzou,
and he's good at building ships, mo.

rows.label: bf03040100_0130
rows.name: Hello!

rows.label: bf03040100_0140
rows.name: Greetings.

rows.label: bf03040100_0150
rows.name: Thank you for having us.

rows.label: bf03040100_0160
rows.name:
I see, Tora's friends, mo.
It's good to make more friends, mo.

rows.label: bf03040100_0170
rows.name: Tora, you've grown up well, mo.

rows.label: bf03040100_0180
rows.name: Hehehe!

rows.label: bf03040100_0190
rows.name: So, what brings you here today, mo?

rows.label: bf03040100_0200
rows.name:
Actually, we came to ask if we could borrow
a ship from you, Uncle Umon, mo.

rows.label: bf03040100_0210
rows.name:
A ship, mo? There are plenty
at Torigo's port, mo.

rows.label: bf03040100_0220
rows.name: Why did you come all the way out here, mo?

rows.label: bf03040100_0230
rows.name: Oh...erm...well...

rows.label: bf03040100_0240
rows.name: Could it be... you don't have any money, mo?

rows.label: bf03040100_0250
rows.name:
Y-yeah. Actually, Tora spent all his money
making Hana, the artificial Blade...

rows.label: bf03040100_0260
rows.name: and ended up completely broke, mo.

rows.label: bf03040100_0270
rows.name:
I thought I'd take a little boat trip
for a change of pace, but the fare...

rows.label: bf03040100_0280
rows.name:
You really can just make up
one lie after another.

rows.label: bf03040100_0290
rows.name: There's no other option.

rows.label: bf03040100_0300
rows.name:
We can't exactly tell him
we fled Torigo, can we?

rows.label: bf03040100_0310
rows.name: Yeah, I guess you're right...

rows.label: bf03040100_0320
rows.name:
Tora is thinking this
through in his own way.

rows.label: bf03040100_0330
rows.name:
An artificial Blade? Is that what Senzou-san
and the others were researching?

rows.label: bf03040100_0340
rows.name: I'm Hana, mo. Pleased to meet you, mo.

rows.label: bf03040100_0350
rows.name: Ohh! So this is it...

rows.label: bf03040100_0360
rows.name:
Wow, incredible, mo! As expected
of Senzou-san's grandson, mo.

rows.label: bf03040100_0370
rows.name:
All right, I understand, mo. In that case,
I'd be happy to lend you a ship anytime...

rows.label: bf03040100_0380
rows.name:
is what I'd like to say,
but I can't right now, mo.

rows.label: bf03040100_0390
rows.name: Wh-why, mo?

rows.label: bf03040100_0400
rows.name: Actually, this ship's still being built, mo.

rows.label: bf03040100_0410
rows.name:
It's almost finished, but I'm short on materials,
so work has stopped, mo.

rows.label: bf03040100_0420
rows.name: That's the only problem?

rows.label: bf03040100_0430
rows.name:
That's right, mo. It's a serious problem,
higher than mountains, deeper than the Cloud Sea, mo.

rows.label: bf03040100_0440
rows.name:
So if you had the materials,
you could finish the ship, right?

rows.label: bf03040100_0450
rows.name: Well, that's right, mo.

rows.label: bf03040100_0460
rows.name: Then if we gather those materials for you...

rows.label: bf03040100_0470
rows.name:
Of course. I'll hurry and finish the ship,
then lend it to you, mo.

rows.label: bf03040100_0480
rows.name: Great! Let's hurry, Tora, everyone!

rows.label: bf03040100_0490
rows.name:
Got it, mo!
Let's all go gather the materials, mo!
